description: This file defines an abstract ViewModel class for managing note data, preferences, and synchronization status in an Android application. It combines preferences and note data streams, and provides a data container class.

classes.name: AbstractNotesViewModel
classes.description: An abstract ViewModel class that manages notes data, preferences, and synchronization state, providing a flow of combined data for UI consumption.

methods.name: isSyncingEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether synchronization is enabled based on the backend provider.
